    LargeIndecomposable.AR.exists_rightAlmostSplit

    Existence of right almost split maps #

    Let A be a k-algebra and Z a module with a free presentation P, local endomorphism ring, and not a summand of a finite free module. Put τZ = ker (ν F). Choose a functional η on End_A(Z) vanishing on the non-units with η(1) ≠ 0, and φ : Z → DAⁿ⁰ with θ(φ)(e(z)) = η(e). Then φ lands in the range of ν F, and the pullback E = {(x, λ) | φ x = ν F λ} with its projection g : E → Z is right almost split (exists_rightAlmostSplit): g is not a split epimorphism, and every map u : W → Z that is not a split epimorphism factors through g.

    The proof is the Auslander–Reiten formula Ext¹(W, τZ) ≅ D Hom(Z, W) (modulo maps through projectives) made explicit with the presentation; no Ext functor is needed.
